main_topics.reason: The user described a first episode of shimmering zigzag vision before a usual migraine and sought help understanding it.
The user asked whether to go to the ER that night or arrange non-urgent care, and agreed to book with a family doctor.
The user said the new symptom scared them and asked whether it could signal a stroke, later reporting they felt calmer.
The user asked whether aura would become a permanent or recurring feature after this first episode.
The user asked whether aura could signal when to take their usual sumatriptan and appreciated the caution about changing its timing.
The user asked about aura and birth control and said they had considered hormonal contraception, though they are not using it now.

output.summary: The user described a new, shimmering visual disturbance before a familiar migraine and worried it might indicate a stroke or require an ER visit. The assistant said the description sounded consistent with migraine aura, gave warning signs and suggested a non-urgent doctor appointment; it also discussed aura recurrence, sumatriptan timing and hormonal contraception. The user said they felt calmer and planned to book with their family doctor that week and rest.
